ModMetadata.Name: ScriptedScreens Vector [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: Gruffuss
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]ScriptedScreens Vector[/h1] [i]Crisp, animated vector graphics for ScriptedScreens consoles. Client-side only.[/i]
Adds a [b]vector[/b] element: describe a screen once -- shapes, gradients, text, pictures -- and the game draws it as sharp geometry at any size and animates it on your machine. No per-frame Lua, no per-frame network traffic, and a fraction of the cost of a canvas console.
[h2]Highlights[/h2] [list] [*] Rounded panels, paths, liquid tanks, waves, charts and particle fields [*] Linear, radial and conic gradients, real transparency, soft and inner shadows [*] Any number -- and any colour -- can be an expression over time, repeat index or your data, so gauges move smoothly and a button lights under the pointer with nothing sent to the chip [*] Clipping, scrolling lists, clickable nodes and text in any game font [*] Tessellated on a worker thread: an animated console costs well under 1% of a frame [/list]
[h2]Getting started[/h2] The mod folder holds eighteen examples that run on paste, a guide (README.md), a full reference (REFERENCE.md) and the release history (CHANGELOG.md), also [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector/tree/main/ScriptedScreensVector]on GitHub[/url]. With StationeersLua installed, AI editors can read and search the same docs through its MCP server.
[h2]What's new (0.11.31 to 0.11.86)[/h2] [list] [*] [b]Smooth glows.[/b] Soft fades and shadows no longer band: coverage rides in a float channel and the output is dithered per pixel [*] [b]Colours can be expressions[/b] -- [b]f = "=if(down,#A,if(hover,#B,#C))"[/b] is a three-state button in one node, and [b]mix(a,b,t)[/b] blends between two [*] [b]Everything is clickable[/b]: polylines, polygons, splines and paths register hit areas, and an open shape answers along its stroke [*] Letter spacing ([b]kern[/b]), closed splines ([b]SP close = 1[/b]), per-corner radii, defaults on the scene root, and [b]v = 0[/b] on any node [*] [b]blur[/b] on a group reaches every closed shape, and gradients fade the way a browser does [*] Three new examples: the pointer, pictures, and line ends [*] [b]Nothing nests too deep[/b] -- groups, expressions and arrays go as far as you like, and a scene built by a tool is no longer a special case [*] Many fixes, including several that could stop a console drawing or end the game outright [/list] Full history: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector/blob/main/ScriptedScreensVector/CHANGELOG.md]CHANGELOG.md[/url].
[h2]Requirements[/h2] [list] [*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3666779631]ScriptedScreens[/url] (required) [*] [url=https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad]StationeersLaunchPad[/url] with [url=https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx]BepInEx 5.x[/url] [/list] Source: [url=https://github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector]github.com/Gruffuss/scripted-screens-vector[/url] (MIT).
